heroSummary: QA Manager and Test Architect with 12+ years of experience leading quality engineering across OTT streaming, fintech, e-commerce, and mobile platforms for Fortune 500 organizations. I architect test automation frameworks from the ground up, establish early shift-left quality practices, and run end-to-end testing across web, mobile, API, and cloud services. about: Quality engineering leader specializing in test automation architecture, shift-left testing strategy, and the practical application of AI in modern QA workflows. Over 12+ years, I have architected and scaled test systems for Fortune 500 enterprises including Paramount Pictures, Pilot Flying J, Falabella, The Travelers Companies, and Equifax. My technical depth spans hands-on test engineering with Playwright, Appium, Selenium, OTT DRM validation (Widevine, FairPlay), media QC pipelines, and CI/CD quality gates. Today, my work bridges deterministic engineering with AI — building agentic coding workflows, multimodal screenshot analysis, and explainable self-healing test automation.

projects.title: Smart Playwright Protocol
projects.description: SPP is a protocol-driven workflow for AI-assisted Playwright automation — defining an auditable contract for how AI agents and engineers collaborate on test tasks. It enforces a strict 6-phase engineering lifecycle (Select → Understand → Explore → Plan → Implement → Verify) using Markdown task contracts, deterministic verification gates, and Page Object best practices. Features a dedicated CLI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration to manage task state and coordinate autonomous agents under explicit engineering control.

projects.title: Testing LLM Automation Engine
projects.description: An LLM + vision AI automation framework for Playwright that addresses three core challenges: generating TypeScript tests from DOM context, generating tests from screenshots using multimodal vision models, and automatically healing broken specs. The self-healer runs an auditable Monitor → Investigate → Reason → Act → Report pipeline, combining deterministic heuristics for fast error classification with LLM reasoning. Every repair emits a structured HealingDecision artifact with confidence scoring, diagnostic evidence, code patches, and verification results.
